action_items: OPTIONAL/MINOR: Landing (path '/') uses useSeo but not useJsonLd, so the homepage's build/index.html lacks a <script id='ld-json-webpage'> node. Homepage still has the full Organization+WebSite+Person @graph in public/index.html, so schema coverage isn't lost, but if the requirement explicitly needs a per-page WebPage JSON-LD on '/', add `useJsonLd(page)` to the Landing component.
critical_code_review_comments: prerender.js catches per-route errors but overall process exits 0 even if some routes fail — consider `process.exit(1)` when results.length < routes.length so CI/deploy pipelines can fail-fast.

prerender.js relies on `waitUntil: networkidle0` + a fixed 400ms delay to let React effects (useSeo/useJsonLd) run. Works today but is a bit fragile if a heavy async component (e.g. Portfolio images fetch) is ever added at root — consider explicitly `waitForFunction(() => document.head.querySelector('meta[property="og:title"]'))`.
Seo.jsx setTag helper decides <link> vs <meta> only via `selector.startsWith('link')` — fine, but leaves no path for <script>; injectJsonLd handles that separately which is good.
